title: PayNearMe Launches AI Servicing and Collections Agent
key_facts: PayNearMe, a California-based payment experience company, unveiled an AI Servicing and Collections Agent this week.
The agent handles inbound self-service for consumers and outbound engagement about collections.
It calls and texts customers, answers inbound calls, and helps customers make or schedule payments, resolve payment issues and address other account needs.
It can connect customers to a human contact when needed.
It is built on PayNearMe's Payment Experience Management platform (PayXM), used by financial institutions, lenders, gaming companies and mortgage servicers.
Indiana Finance Company is piloting it for proactive outreach campaigns and inbound support; its COO Carl Stamper says it gives 'the reach of a much larger team'.
The launch follows PayNearMe's acquisition of Marr Labs' technology assets and key employees.
quote_evidence: PayNearMe’s new Agent calls and texts customers, answers inbound calls, and helps customers make or schedule payments, resolve payment issues, and address other account needs.
While the tool can help automate much of the collections process, it can also connect them to a human contact when needed.
“The AI Agent gives us the reach of a much larger team and lets us adjust the pace of campaigns based on our needs,” said Indiana Finance Company COO Carl Stamper.
why_it_matters_hint: AI agents are starting to phone and text people about money they owe, with a human handover when needed.
event_date: 'This week' (week of 28 Sep 2026); exact day not stated. Finovate published 2 Oct 2026.
notes: Claims come from PayNearMe and a pilot customer; no independent results or data on how many people were contacted. Finovate adds its own view that agentic AI in finance is moving from helping to doing, which was not used as fact.
